commands.teaching: When you suspect MindrianOS has a newer version waiting, /mos:update checks and installs via Claude Code's native plugin loader. Stale plugins quietly diverge from the docs.
commands.jtbd_summary: Audit Data Room health - gaps, drift, evidence tier, decision quality.

commands.teaching: When you need to map what users actually want versus what they say they want, /mos:user-needs plots importance against satisfaction. The gap is where the opportunity lives.
commands.jtbd_summary: Find the problem worth solving (not the symptom, the root).

commands.teaching: When an idea needs a real test before more investment, /mos:validate runs importance-satisfaction scoring against the customer segment. Validation is a measurement, not a feeling.
commands.jtbd_summary: Test if an idea / hypothesis / claim holds up under scrutiny.

commands.teaching: When you have a value proposition but no proof it holds, /mos:validate-proposition scores it against the three PWS VP gates with sequential math. A clean gate failure beats a vague pass.
commands.jtbd_summary: Test if an idea / hypothesis / claim holds up under scrutiny.

commands.teaching: When you want the Data Room available in Obsidian for offline reading, /mos:vault exports it as a nested vault with wikilinks intact. Graph view comes free.
commands.jtbd_summary: Prepare for an investor / partner / customer meeting.

commands.teaching: Deprecated alias. Use /mos:dashboard --mermaid to open the De Stijl knowledge-graph viewer with Mermaid output; visualize folds into the dashboard surface. Scheduled removal: v1.14.0.
commands.jtbd_summary: Audit Data Room health - gaps, drift, evidence tier, decision quality.

commands.teaching: When you suspect a gap exists in the room's coverage of a domain, /mos:whitespace runs HSI scoring across the artifact corpus to find under-explored zones. Best after the room has 20+ entries.
commands.jtbd_summary: Find cross-domain analogues - what does this look like in another field?

commands.teaching: When you want to read the Data Room as linked wiki pages, /mos:wiki opens the wiki view. Section by section, with cross-references rendered as hyperlinks.
commands.jtbd_summary: Audit Data Room health - gaps, drift, evidence tier, decision quality.
